title: Studio's automation canvas header still prints the literal 'flow · <api name>' chip, the residual of objectui#11659 ruling 6
body:
## Source

This is the residual of objectstack-ai/objectui#11659 ruling 6. That ruling made Studio's automation-pillar copy plain language. objectui#11663 (its PR) cleaned the pillar copy. It left one surface, outside that card's file surface: when a flow is open, the automation canvas header in `StudioDesignSurface` renders a literal chip `flow · <api name>` in every locale.

## Ruling

The maintainer delegated this decision to the epic PM on 2026-10-05 (「你不用找我确认，你自己确认」). The ruling: the zh header must not show the metadata type word `flow`. Show the flow's label. Keep the API name available on hover, for authors who need it.

## Acceptance

1. With a flow open in zh-CN, the canvas header shows no `flow` token, and hovering shows the API name.
2. The en header follows the same rule.
3. A test pins both, and is ablated once.

Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#2636.
